instruments.notes: Fixed-to-floating swaps purchased during 2002 and 2001 to convert fixed-price physical gas contracts to index price; 4 million cubic feet per day (stated as 4 MMcf/d, expressed as 4000 Mcf/d); contract prices range from $3.06 to $6.08 per Mcf (no single weighted-average fixed price stated); expire in 2003. Fair value 2 is from the 2002 derivative table (Natural Gas Swaps), currency units not confirmed as US vs Cdn.
instruments.evidence_quote:
we must deliver 4 million cubic feet per day of natural gas to counterparties at
prices ranging from $3.06 to $6.08 per thousand cubic feet.

instruments.notes: Put options purchased during 2001 and 2000 to establish a minimum WTI-based crude price; strike price and volumes not stated; US $13 million premium paid in 2001; contracts expired unexercised in 2002 (historical, none outstanding at year-end 2002).
instruments.evidence_quote:
During 2001 and 2000, we purchased put options to establish a minimum
price for our crude oil to mitigate the impact of any price declines.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: Majority of production sold under short-term market-based contracts; at times uses futures, forwards, swaps and options. Manages exposure to the extent practical; marketing arm uses derivatives for hedging and trading.
